profile.name: 非持久模式磁体线圈
profile.description: 一种在非持久模式下工作的磁体线圈，用于在实验中产生和调节磁场。此类线圈通常通过外部电流源连续供电，常见于低温测量、量子器件表征及其他需要可控磁场偏置的实验。
profile.description_en: A magnet coil operated in non-persistent mode, used to generate and adjust magnetic fields in laboratory experiments. This type of coil is typically driven continuously by an external current source and is commonly used in cryogenic measurements, quantum device characterization, and other setups requiring a controllable magnetic field bias.
